chains.title: Work competes with keeping a body alive
chains.prerequisites: Reason and an unfilled job route permit clerical acquisition; actual junior job enables work.
chains.decision: Commit Work to earning or divert scarce time toward occult actions.
chains.actual_spend_and_mutation: Junior work produces one Funds after 60; reason diligence substitutes a branch with further linked Funds and careeradvancement, rather than consuming every prerequisite. Needs grabs one Funds; discardseason applies funds -999 in its local storage. GreedyAngel splits one from a larger stack, so -999 is local cleanup, not a global wallet wipe.
chains.downstream_consumer: Funds pays the next needs cycle and illness recovery. Employment and careeradvancement xtriggers refresh/change job identity.
chains.time_and_absence: Needs is 60; junior job lifetime is 90 and absence converts it to demotion.
chains.failure_and_aftermath: No Funds selects starvation: Health loss/Hunger; no Health or Fatigue can end the body. Demotion admits a 30-time Passion plea that transforms the job back.

chains.title: Illness is a deadline with several recovery currencies
chains.prerequisites: Sickness season, Health/Fatigue, or injury from damagehealth.
chains.decision: Use Funds or Vitality and occupy Dream for treatment; prioritize it against other opportunities.
chains.actual_spend_and_mutation: Health fallsick xtrigger changes it into affliction; recovery spends one Funds or one Vitality and emits restorehealth to change affected card to Health. Requirements are eligibility, effects/xtriggers are actual spend/change.
chains.downstream_consumer: Recovered Health can work, dream and withstand later sickness. Decrepitude remains an ability/remnant and can enter a later ingredient route.
chains.time_and_absence: Affliction lifetime180, Injury150. Fatigue lifetime60 returns Health automatically. Dream treatment takes60; hunger treatment30.
chains.failure_and_aftermath: Untreated Injury/Affliction decays to Decrepitude. A special ingredientheartf route spends the ingredient and tohealth restores it; failed ingredient route consumes ingredient and produces Erudition. No automatic full reset.

chains.title: A useful mental state can become a fatal accumulation
chains.prerequisites: Despair season starts risk, and Dread has inducesdespair1; fascination enters a parallel risk.
chains.decision: Spend Contentment to calm Dread, or deliberately use Dread/Fleeting to reduce Fascination.
chains.actual_spend_and_mutation: Despairabate removes one inducesdespair and one Contentment. Visionsabate removes one Fascination and one Dread; fleeting alternative spends Fleeting. Same resources have defensive and occult consumers.
chains.downstream_consumer: Dream reducedread/reducefascination shares these resources with the spontaneous hazard; surviving produces Fleeting.
chains.time_and_absence: Risk/active warmups60; Dread and Fascination lifetime180; Contentment60. Hazard greedily reserves cards and offers a final intervention window.
chains.failure_and_aftermath: Three inducesdespair or Fascination selects a 60-time ending route with an alternate abatement opportunity. Warning at two changes prediction. Exhaustion without usable relief can end the life.

chains.title: Occult advancement creates a recurring lifestyle obligation
chains.prerequisites: Power desireb, Stag-door achievement and Forge6 enable upgrade to obsessionc.
chains.decision: Accept the obligation, pay recurring Funds, or let it regress.
chains.actual_spend_and_mutation: Upgrade removes desireb and creates desirec. Ambition selects powermarks and grabs Funds; success consumes one Funds, creates two Vitality and emits ascend, changing c to d and onward. Failure consumes Vitality if present and emits descend/damagehealth.
chains.downstream_consumer: Power marks become requirements for later craving and ritual ending; stagef plus ritual/Forge36 opens the minor victory chain.
chains.time_and_absence: Seasonambitions routes ambition10 then craving30; failure branch adds30. Progress is repeatedly revisited by the life clock.
chains.failure_and_aftermath: Insufficient Funds steps desire backward and may injure Health. Threshold alone does not end the life: ritual trigger spends follower/summoned/passion quantities before a later overture.

chains.title: A terminal ambition can still be refused for a relationship
chains.prerequisites: Minor Forge ritual trigger followed by overture; romanticinterest without corpse/notoriety can be greedily drawn.
chains.decision: During belovedfarewell, add Passion to choose a mortal relationship outcome; do nothing to continue ascent.
chains.actual_spend_and_mutation: The trigger already applies follower/summoned/passion -3 before overture. Farewell requires romanticinterest and absence of summoned; specific partner ending needs Passion and unique partner aspect. No universal refund or rollback is claimed.
chains.downstream_consumer: Ending ID is sent through Situation.ExecuteCurrentRecipe to the ending handler; it becomes input to next legacy selection.
chains.time_and_absence: Trigger1, overture60, farewell30, specific romance ending60. Choice occurs after earlier costs, rather than a costless preview.
chains.failure_and_aftermath: Absent relationship or Passion falls through linked routes to ascent; raised beloved changes the selected ending. Native YAIR defeat must not be replaced with these endings by inference.

chains.title: An ending changes the next available life without proving whole-state inheritance
chains.prerequisites: Completed ending ID and registered Legacy definitions.
chains.decision: Choose among ending-dependent and additional legacy starts.
chains.actual_spend_and_mutation: LegacySelector matches FromEnding, adds two random availableWithoutEndingMatch candidates excluding the ending-matched ID and ExcludesOnEnding. Without a valid match it draws three. Apostleforge definition provisions Health2 and a particular job; no whole character transfer established.
chains.downstream_consumer: Ending minorforgevictory unlocks apostleforge start; deathofthebody has physician/brightyoungthing matches, one randomly chosen as ending dependent.
chains.time_and_absence: Selection happens after ending; new Random is used here. Do not copy this into YAIR saved-RNG behavior.
chains.failure_and_aftermath: No valid match logs a warning and offers three. Exclusions prevent duplicate specific starting variants. Save fields and exact persistence inheritance remain unread.

chains.title: Ghoul progression attaches hunger to the desire rather than a generic player meter
chains.prerequisites: prealzabo, temptation.remembrance, corpse, Funds and Passion qualify first taste.
chains.decision: Make the first commitment, then feed hunger through the specialized study path.
chains.actual_spend_and_mutation: ghoul.firsttaste consumes corpse/prealzabo/Funds, creates memory.unexpected/alzabo and sets ghoul.hunger1 on matching desire. MutationEffect defaults Additive=false. Seasonal remembrance craving increments hunger additively when already present; reducehunger branches subtract one additively.
chains.downstream_consumer: At ghoul.hunger7 ambition can choose minorcrownedgrowthvictory. Generated memory is a source-backed output; entire memory corpus not read.
chains.time_and_absence: First taste30 and craving30; the obligation returns with ambition seasons.
chains.failure_and_aftermath: Omitting upkeep changes the attached hunger state toward the threshold; exact prerequisite routing into every feeding branch is unread. This is bounded DLC mutation coverage, not a completed Ghoul campaign.

inference: Original adaptation proposals are in IMPLEMENTATION_PACKETS.md. No source-analysis observation proves playable YAIR behavior.
